description_en: This API returns the status and configuration of native replication instances
description_zh: 该接口用于查询原生复制实例状态与配置
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-db-instance-replication --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmx0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBInstanceReplication

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent list of regions
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the details of an instance
parameters.name: db_instance_id

ExternalReplication.description_en:
Indicates whether native replication is enabled. Valid values:

ON: Enabled.

OFF: Disabled
ExternalReplication.description_zh:
开启或关闭原生复制模式，返回值如下：
ON：开启。
OFF：关闭
ExternalReplication.title_zh:

The current replication state. Valid values:

Running

Connecting

Stopped

Error

当前复制状态，返回值如下：

Running：运行中
Connecting：正在连接

LastIoErrno.description_en: The number of the last error that occurred on the I/O thread. A value of `0` indicates that no error occurred
LastIoErrno.description_zh: 0表示无错误，其他值表示IO线程的错误代码

LastIoError.description_en: The message of the last error that occurred on the I/O thread

LastSqlErrno.description_en: The number of the last error that occurred on the SQL thread. A value of `0` indicates that no error occurred
LastSqlErrno.description_zh: 0表示无错误，其他值表示SQL线程的错误代码
